turns.request: Add an inception year relativity to base_premium, keyed on inception_year: 1.0 for 2024 and 1.04 for 2025+, with 1.0 for anything else, as inception_relativity. It should multiply into the premium like the other tables.

execution.golden:
df = pl.scan_parquet('data/batch_quotes.parquet').with_columns(
    driver_age=((pl.col('inception_date') - pl.col('date_of_birth')).dt.total_days() // 365).cast(pl.Int64),
    vehicle_value_k=(pl.col('vehicle_value') / 1000).round(1),
)
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
model = CatBoostRegressor()
model.load_model('models/claim_frequency.cbm')
features = df.collect()
scores = model.predict(features.select('vehicle_value', 'vehicle_group', 'driver_age').to_pandas())
df = features.with_columns(expected_frequency=pl.Series(scores, dtype=pl.Float64))
df = df.with_columns(
    age_band=pl.when(pl.col('driver_age') <= 24).then(pl.lit('17-24')).when(pl.col('driver_age') <= 59).then(pl.lit('25-59')).when(pl.col('driver_age').is_not_null()).then(pl.lit('60+')).otherwise(pl.lit('unknown')),
    inception_year=pl.when(pl.col('inception_date') <= pl.date(2024, 12, 31)).then(pl.lit('2024')).when(pl.col('inception_date').is_not_null()).then(pl.lit('2025+')).otherwise(pl.lit('unknown')),
    region=pl.col('region_code').replace_strict({'NE': 'North', 'NW': 'North', 'SE': 'South', 'LON': 'London'}, default=pl.lit('Other')),
)
df = df.with_columns(
    age_relativity=pl.col('age_band').replace_strict({'17-24': 1.8, '25-59': 1.0, '60+': 1.2}, default=1.0, return_dtype=pl.Float64),
    region_vehicle_relativity=pl.concat_str(['region', 'vehicle_group'], separator='|').replace_strict({'North|A': 0.9, 'North|B': 1.0, 'North|C': 1.2, 'South|A': 1.0, 'South|B': 1.1, 'South|C': 1.3, 'London|A': 1.3, 'London|B': 1.45, 'London|C': 1.7}, default=1.0, return_dtype=pl.Float64),
    inception_relativity=pl.col('inception_year').replace_strict({'2024': 1.0, '2025+': 1.04}, default=1.0, return_dtype=pl.Float64),
)
df = df.with_columns(premium=(320.0 * pl.col('age_relativity') * pl.col('region_vehicle_relativity') * pl.col('inception_relativity')).round(2))
